signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.note: Too many tries make you wait a moment. Forgot it? Run {{command}} on the server. First time here? Set up the admin

firstRun.title: Set up your server
firstRun.lede: This server has no admin yet. It prints a one-time setup code in its log when it starts.
firstRun.note: The code works once, for 30 minutes. Restart the server for a new one, or run {{command}} there.

certificateNote: Your browser warns once about this server's certificate because the server made it itself. Check that the fingerprint it shows matches the one in the server log before you continue.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you to continue?
stepUp.description: This action can expose secrets or change devices. Enter your password again to continue.
stepUp.validFor: Valid for 5 minutes, in this browser only.
